{{Quote|There's a large-scale civil war on Balith. They've requested our assistance. Anakin, you will leave immediately to command the Third Legion.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|audio=CivilWarOnBalith-TCW-Assassin.flac|<ref name="Assassin" />}}
'''Balith''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Assassin" /> in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Balith system/Legends|Balith system]]. It was situated in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] on the [[Vaathkree Trade Corridor/Legends|Vaathkree Trade Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]].<ref name="AtlasBalith" />

A large-scale [[Balith civil war|civil war]] had started on Balith<ref name="Assassin" /> by [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Legends-Date">{{TCWdates|307}}</ref> prompting its inhabitants to request assistance from the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The Republic responded by dispatching [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] to Balith to [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] the [[Third Legion/Legends|Third Legion]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] Skywalker was given the mission, his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] mentioned that she had not been to Balith before. While she was not allowed to join the mission, Tano did accompany her master to a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] that transported the Jedi General from<ref name="Assassin" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to Balith.<ref name="Assassin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Balith's name was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the Balith [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Balith itself, in grid square N-7.<ref name="AtlasBalith" /> That mention was made due to the authors having been made aware beforehand of the celestial body being featured in<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Assassin">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode307.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Assassin}}</ref> "[[Assassin (episode)|Assassin]],"<ref name="Assassin" /> the seventh episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated series which aired on [[October 22]], [[2010]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Assassin">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode307.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Assassin}}</ref>
